orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.suggestionsHint: Products below their minimum stock are pre-filled.
orders.noSuggestions: No product has this supplier as its usual supplier.
orders.draftOnly: A manager will submit this order.

receiving.title: Receiving
receiving.cameraUnsupported: The camera is not available in this browser.
receiving.returnDraft: A supplier return is prepared for the damaged products ({name}).
receiving.lines: {count, plural, =0 {No products} one {# product} other {# products}}
receiving.noVatHint: Entered in ERPNext without VAT: its stock is valued VAT included, so costs and margins are wrong. Correct it to value it without VAT now (the cost of what was sold since is recomputed), or enter the supplier's invoice.
receiving.correctHint: Change what was wrong, then save. The original delivery note is cancelled and replaced on the same date; the cost of what was sold since is recomputed.
receiving.corrected: Delivery corrected: stock and costs updated.
receiving.correctedBy: This delivery note is cancelled: it was replaced by the correction <link>{name}</link>.
receiving.cancelHint: The received stock leaves and the accounting entries are reversed. The delivery note stays in the list as cancelled, with the reason.
receiving.blockedInvoiced: A supplier invoice includes this delivery note: it can no longer be corrected. Correct the invoice or enter a credit note.
receiving.blockedReturned: Goods from this delivery note were sent back to the supplier: cancel that return first to correct it.

invoices.title: Supplier invoices
invoices.noReceipts: No delivery note waiting for this supplier.
invoices.priceDiffers: More than 1% away from the delivery note ({rate}).
invoices.ice: Our ICE is printed on the invoice
invoices.iceWarning: Without our ICE on the invoice, the VAT may not be deductible.
invoices.submitted: Invoice submitted: the amount owed is recorded.
invoices.cashLimit: Cash paid above {daily} a day or {monthly} a month to this supplier: {over} is over the limit and {vat} of VAT will not be deductible.
invoices.cashTotals: Cash paid to this supplier: {day} today, {month} this month (including this payment).
invoices.vatDeductibleNote: The VAT on this invoice becomes deductible once it is paid.
